_note: AI Battle transition art (ai_link, ai_link_back), in 1920x1080 pixels; the chip and the status box are centred on the screen's middle x. SetColor colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1, COLOR colours [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; opacities 0 to 1; texture scales are factors of the texture's own size.

textures._note: the size of Textures/Pixel.png and the length of Textures/Line.png, in their own pixels

chip._note: half: half the chip's side; die: the inner square sits this far inside it, drawn with a die_frame px frame; the pin 1 mark is a Dot.png at mark_scale

traces._note: from each pin: a straight run (run_side for the left and right pins, run_end for the top and bottom ones), a 45 degree bend, then straight on to edge_overshoot px past the screen edge or to a via. Left and right traces end in rows around side_mid, spread side_spread times the pin's offset; top and bottom ones in columns spread end_spread times. A trace with more than via_min_room px left ends at a via with chance via_chance, at least via_min_run px further. glow_width is the glow's height scale under each line

box._note: the status box at y (its middle): at least min_width wide, pad px either side of the text; corner squares of corner px; text_pad is the glyph box's side padding
